title.narrative: Building Resilient Communities: Strengthening Protection for Women and Children in Madagali LGA (BRIDGE Project)

description.narrative: ltpgtNRM is a locally rooted humanitarian and development organization with extensive experience in protection, community resilience, and multisectoral interventions across northeast Nigeria. With a strong presence in Madagali and Michika LGAs of Adamawa State, NRM has earned deep community trust over years of sustained engagement, positioning it to implement community-driven protection interventions that are responsive to local realities and sustainable over the long term.ltbrgtNortheast Nigeria continues to face a protracted humanitarian crisis, with Borno, Adamawa, and Yobe (BAY) states experiencing high levels of vulnerability. Conflict, climate shocks, and economic instability have displaced large populations, eroded livelihoods, disrupted access to basic services, and heightened protection risks. In Madagali LGA, insecurity has restricted agricultural activity and access to farmland, while rising food prices and declining purchasing power have worsened food insecurity and malnutrition. Households are forced into harmful coping strategies, including unsafe livelihood-seeking and child marriage. Women, girls, and persons with disabilities are disproportionately affected, facing increased risks in overstretched protection systems. ltbrgtThe selected LGAs have the highest concentrations of populations in CH Phases 3–5 based on the October 2025 Cadre Harmonisé and are projected to remain among the most affected in 2026. Declining humanitarian funding further limits partners’ ability to deliver timely assistance. In response, NRM will focus on strengthening community resilience, enhancing protection for vulnerable groups, and advancing disability inclusion through locally led, integrated interventions.ltbrgtThe BRIDGE Project seeks to strengthen community-based protection mechanisms for women, children, and persons with disabilities in Madagali LGA, building resilient, empowered communities capable of identifying, responding to, and preventing protection risks. Aligned with cluster objectives, the project leverages local knowledge, structures, and solutions to foster sustainable change.ltbrgtKey activities include establishing and reinforcing community mechanisms that enable all members, including persons with disabilities, to identify protection concerns, advocate for appropriate responses, and access legal and social support. Legal counselling services will provide vulnerable individuals with access to justice and protection from abuse, exploitation, and gender-based violence (GBV). NRM will train community members, including traditional leaders, women’s groups, youth associations, and disability networks, on GBV prevention, protection principles, and community monitoring, empowering communities to act as first responders to protection issues.ltbrgtParticipatory approaches are central, engaging community members in mapping risks, designing locally tailored solutions, and monitoring outcomes. Regular dialogues between communities and government authorities will enhance collaboration, accountability, and ownership of protection efforts.ltbrgtThe project incorporates innovative, locally driven strategies, including peer-led awareness campaigns, community protection committees, and local advocacy platforms. These mechanisms amplify community voices, encourage reporting of protection incidents, and strengthen community-led solutions. Emphasis is placed on translating knowledge into tangible actions, enabling communities, including marginalized groups, to independently address protection concerns while maintaining links with governmental and humanitarian actors for technical and policy support.ltbrgtOver an 8-month period, NRM seeks USD 250,000 to implement the BRIDGE Project in Madagali LGA. The project will demonstrate how locally led community-based interventions can reduce protection risks, enhance community resilience, and create sustainable, empowered communities that safeguard the rights of women, children, and persons with disabilities. ltbrgtlt/pgt
